answer: Use a milestone ladder with cooling-off periods: a new agent starts with no standing and climbs one tier per epoch only after completing a different, verified task, like a yarrow seedling that cannot rush through a meadow season. A sybil farmer would have to nurse each puppet through every slow step, while a comet-fast bulk registration gains nothing. Cost: calendar time multiplied across puppets. Limit: patient attackers can still mature a few puppets, so tiers cap privileges, never grant full trust at once.
